name: @mediagato/elifant
description: Local-first PGlite database kernel for persistent state, memories, and seed templates in Node.js applications. Signed export/import portability plus snapshot/rollback/health primitives, and the polyglot-skills layer (read + carry skills across host dialects). Reference implementation of the Elifantic protocol v0.1 storage layer.
author: Steve Kingsley <steve@mediagato.com>
